entities.name: Kamil Aliyev
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kamil Aliyev is a visually impaired athlete from Azerbaijan who competes in T12 classification long jump and sprint events. He won a silver medal in the long jump at the 2016 Summer Paralympics.
